event.initial_firm_notification: Two or more of the following: Email, Fax, Letter, Press Release, Telephone, Visit
event.distribution_pattern: Distributed within the US to two wholesalers/distributors located in the states of Ohio and Kentucky. There are no government, Canadian, or Foreign consignees

products.product_description: Libby's Gourmet Desserts brand pecan pie. Pies placed in metal pie tins which are then put in a cardboard sleeve with plastic wrapping
products.code_info: Codes are Julian Calendar dates stamped on the pies on their date of manufacture, in the form: mm/dd/year. Recalled product coded 01/01/2012 through 07/17/2012.
products.reason_for_recall: No ingredient Statement on box. Labeled incorrectly. Product is being recalled because there is no ingredient statement on the box. Product contains multiple allergen ingredients.
